title: Evia Coach review snapshot
details: Evia now keeps a private local review-period ledger for meaningful vocational activity
The assessor QR now includes an anonymous Coach Snapshot covering engagement, course progress, evidence, OTJ or GLH, Test practice, targets, confidence and wellbeing check-in activity
A completed Milos review closes the current period and starts the next review period automatically
No learner name, contact details, media files, written evidence or signatures are placed in the Coach Snapshot
summary: Evia v231 turns the assessor QR into a review-period Coach Snapshot so Milos can understand what has happened between progress reviews.
changes: Anonymous Coach Snapshot in assessor QR
Evidence counts by photo, video, audio and written evidence
OTJ or GLH movement since the review
EPA, Maths and English practice summaries
Target, confidence and wellbeing review-period summaries
Automatic new review period after a completed Milos review
